title: Ex Cinere Alius
description: Modpack for the Ex Cinere Alius server
body:
## Modpack for the Ex Cinere Alius server (private)

- Many performance optimizations.
- QoL improvments such as inventory sorting.
- Cosmetic improvements from Vanilla Tweaks.
- Distant Horizons and Shaders (disabled by default) to make everything beautiful.
- Accessories mod for wearing chestplate with elytra

Credits:  
Vanilla Tweaks: https://vanillatweaks.net/
